objective: Frozen computation: naive serial laws and the closure law on the cluster map, in random orders, on rings, joins and census starts; order dependence, round-free ratios, part shares.
status: Supported in part 2026-11-19 (P2, P3 held; P1, P4 failed; referee pending): present-state serial laws build order-dependent, thinner structures than rounds (0 of 280 orders match ranks 0-3) and the order decides survival (touching knots die in 4 of 20 orders); joins-first is order-free but always kills two small trees; part shares by size: each part alone keeps exactly its stand-alone growth, over 96.7% of clusters of size 10+ span the joint.
title: Serial orders, frozen
